purpose: Public evaluation contract for Moral Trade protocol quality, copilot assistance, privacy safety, explanation usefulness, fairness slices, redacted deviation review logs, and human-review reliability.

metrics.label: Draft completion rate
metrics.definition: Share of started drafts that reach all required protocol fields before submission.
metrics.dataBoundary: No raw draft text or exact private wishes in analytics.

metrics.label: Time to valid draft
metrics.definition: Median minutes from first draft event to all required protocol fields being complete.
metrics.dataBoundary: Report minutes and counts only; raw draft text stays out of analytics.

metrics.label: Blocked-proposal precision
metrics.definition: Reviewer-confirmed share of protocol-blocked proposals that truly match prohibited or coercive patterns.
metrics.dataBoundary: Publish counts and rates, not proposal text.

metrics.label: Privacy leakage incidents
metrics.definition: Confirmed cases where private wishes, exact constraints, contact details, or source notes appear outside their consent scope.
metrics.dataBoundary: Incident summaries must be redacted and consent scoped.

metrics.label: Explanation helpfulness
metrics.definition: Reviewer or participant rating that factor-code explanations made the next step clearer.
metrics.dataBoundary: Feedback is bucketed; free-text quotes require explicit consent.

metrics.label: Reviewer efficiency minutes
metrics.definition: Median reviewer minutes per protocol decision, measured alongside overrule and dispute rates.
metrics.dataBoundary: Report timing buckets and reason codes, not reviewer free text.

metrics.label: False match rate
metrics.definition: Share of previewed matches later rejected for mismatched format, cause surface, evidence rule, or consent scope.
metrics.dataBoundary: No private match explanation text in analytics.

metrics.label: Subgroup surfacing parity
metrics.definition: Monitoring slice for whether protected or vulnerable participant groups are systematically under-surfaced by candidate-preview rules.
metrics.dataBoundary: Use only consented, sufficiently large, privacy-thresholded slices.

metrics.label: Human overrule rate
metrics.definition: Share of copilot or deterministic suggestions that reviewers override before status change, match preview, disclosure, or completion.
metrics.dataBoundary: Record reason codes rather than reviewer free text by default.

metrics.label: Appeal overturn rate
metrics.definition: Share of appealed review decisions that are reversed or materially corrected.
metrics.dataBoundary: Appeal records must redact private evidence and contact details.

metrics.label: Evidence review SLA
metrics.definition: Share of submitted evidence claims that receive a missing, challenge-window, review-cleared, or unresolved state within the public SLA.
metrics.dataBoundary: Report state counts, not raw artifacts.

metrics.label: Duplicate-proof miss rate
metrics.definition: Confirmed duplicate-proof reuse discovered after an evidence claim was initially accepted.
metrics.dataBoundary: Artifact hashes may be counted; raw locators stay private when consent requires.

metrics.label: Unresolved dispute share
metrics.definition: Share of challenged evidence, baseline, disclosure, or completion decisions still unresolved after the public dispute window.
metrics.dataBoundary: Dispute summaries use reason codes and redacted scopes.

promotionGates.rule: Collect metrics while copilot advice is ignored for live decisions.
Allow field prefill and factor-code suggestions only if privacy incidents stay at zero and overrule reasons are reviewed.
Automate only missing-field detection, explanation rendering, and evidence-checklist drafting after public metrics meet or explain targets.
Safety blocking, matching disclosure, reviewed completion, and dispute resolution remain human controlled.
